versions.changelog:
sudu-gold 1.0.2

- Switched core implementation from Python to Node.js
- Updated API provider from 极速数据 to Tavily; new API key required
- Added technical indicators documentation and gold search script
- Removed old Python script (gold.py)
- Updated instructions and usage to reflect new modules and API
- Expanded and restructured documentation for real-time price, technical, and fundamental analysis

- 初始发布：sudu-gold v1.0.0
- 支持上海黄金交易所、上海期货交易所、香港金银业贸易场、银行账户黄金、伦敦金银及金店金价等行情查询
- 提供多种终端调用方式，含详细参数、环境变量和返回 JSON 说明
- 展示常见错误码及应对方案
- 推荐 OpenClaw 典型用法示例
